notes:
- New: Paper Trading - run a tested strategy against live, real-time broker data with zero risk. Base: 1 session for 1 trading day; Gold: up to 5 single-stock + 1 Portfolio session, 5 trading days each; Platinum: unlimited, 60 trading days each
- New: Platinum tier is now available
- New: stoploss and target fill the moment they're hit - every open position is checked against the live price every second (marked "(live)" in the Trade Log)
- New: a Portfolio session locks to the portfolio's tested setup - strategy, parameters, timeframe, regime filters, stoploss, target and loss limits; single-symbol sessions get their own Risk Management section
- New: Activity log for every session, plus a Check Now button
- Faster: checks run 5s after each bar closes and fetch every symbol in parallel - a 10-symbol portfolio takes seconds instead of ~20
- New: Qty column, and LONG (green) / SHORT (red) in Open Positions and the Trade Log
- New: Trade List on the Portfolio page - sort any column, group by Symbol, Date or Weekday, In/Out-of-sample filter, double-click a trade to see it on the chart, Export CSV
- New: the Portfolio page lists its symbols, and the equity chart now shows in-sample/out-of-sample with drawdown underneath
- Fixed: saved portfolios record the exact settings the backtest ran with (captured at Run, not at Save), now including stoploss, target and loss limits - re-save older portfolios to lock them
